title: London Stadium
geometryBasis: The OSM stadium multipolygon contains 59 outer and 69 inner roof controls. The mapped turf controls pitch centre and bearing, and the mapped southeast entrance fixes the datum.
sectionBasis: The independent original DEM places the field about 5.1 m below the southeast approach. The synthetic field surface sits 0.17 m above the sample mean to avoid cutting the preserved elevation. Rail, fascia, roof heights and sections are inferred from the mapped shape, released images and engineering text.
limitations: The model depicts the current football layout. Seat counts, interface details, facade pattern and interior service areas are simplified.
The outer and inner roof outlines are mapped. Vertical roof section, cable positions and truss dimensions are original approximate geometry.
The panel artwork, stadium signage, crowd, temporary concert fixtures, and separate nearby buildings and bridges are outside the modeled scope.
